Nov 5th, 2024


Atlas for Shopify


We’re excited to announce that Atlas is now available on Shopify! 🎉 Say goodbye to fragmented support tools—Atlas brings everything you need into one platform, so your team can focus on helping customers and growing your business.


Let’s dive into how you can 10x your Shopify support with Atlas:


Let’s break down the details!


## 👋 Customer Timeline


---


A single timeline for all customer interactions, from first click to last purchase. You’ll have an up-to-date view of each customer’s journey, including past orders, visited pages, and previous support conversations, giving your team the context they need to respond with accuracy.


## 📦 Order Management


---


Directly from the Atlas interface, you can refund, cancel, or duplicate orders—no need to switch between multiple apps.


## 🔄 Session Recording


---


Our Session Recording feature gives you a real-time view of their interactions, so you can identify issues and provide proactive support.


Thanks for being part of our journey to simplify customer support. We can’t wait to hear how Atlas for Shopify is working for you!
